_comment: Golden set v2 floors (the Phase 14.0 plan, section 14.0 / P14-D4). Recorded by block 14-A2 (T14.0.5). T14.2.8 (block 14-C2) turns enforcement on PER METRIC (the `enforce` object below) instead of 14-A2's single global `enforce_now` switch: a metric is enforced once its floor is both in force (14.2 onward, i.e. every floor here) and actually met by the measured numbers; `enforce_now` is kept only as a human-readable note of when enforcement as a concept started, no longer read by gate.py.
_enforce_comment: block 14-C2 (T14.2.8), measured on gate-20261125T102556Z-2507174.log (--only eval) and reconfirmed on the final --full run (see the ADR's '14-C2 decision' table): noisy_recall (1.000), greeting_reply_p95_s (~1.48s) and router_p95_s (~1.05s local) already clear their floor and are enforced from this block on. intent_accuracy (~0.873), follow_up_resolution (0.500) and conversational_reply_rate (0.9375) remain below their floor -- recorded, not enforced; see the ADR for why each gap is expected and which later block (14.3/14-D1) is expected to close it. Flipping any of these three to `true` without first raising the real number would fail `gate.sh --full` outright.
